svg.title: Base-Case Revenue to Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-owner-profit-bridge; chart type: waterfall; title: Base-Case Revenue to Owner Profit; subtitle: $505,000 operator revenue less $292,900 costs equals $212,100.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD annually. First and final bars are totals; the four intermediate bars are signed expense movements. Expense allocation is illustrative; canonical scenario totals are fixed. Conservative is $110,000 revenue at 30% margin, producing $33,000 profit with 1 FT + 3 C. Base is $505,000 at 42.0%, producing $212,100 with the same pod. Scaled is $900,000 at 54%, producing $486,000 with 2 FT + 4 C.; caption: 505,000 − 132,000 − 80,000 − 48,000 − 32,900 = 212,100; 212,100 / 505,000 = 42.0%. Underlying land purchases and developer construction spending never enter operator revenue.; stages: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $505,000 annual earned fees and realized carry; numeric value: 505000.0; detail: Include only earned option assignments, per-MW origination milestones, and realized development carry. Where ASC 606 applies, assess principal versus agent presentation; exclude third-party pass-through billings when only the retained fee is operator revenue.; label: Recurring pod operating expense; value: −$132,000 annual recurring delivery and overhead costs; numeric value: -132000.0; detail: $11,000 monthly covers recurring contractor retainers, software, insurance, administration, and sourcing. This is the upper end of the canonical $1,800–$11,000 monthly operating range; exclude the separate project-specific charges below.; label: Direct site diligence expense; value: −$80,000 project-specific technical and land diligence; numeric value: -80000.0; detail: Allocate $36,000 to utility engineering and study support, $24,000 to environmental and survey work, and $20,000 to land-use and title investigation. These expenses exclude recurring pod retainers.; label: Expired option fee expense; value: −$48,000 recognized losses from unsuccessful site control; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Three failed positions at $16,000 each absorb nonrefundable option and extension fees after utility or zoning failure. Do not treat refundable deposits as losses or capitalize expired rights indefinitely.; label: Closed transaction expense; value: −$32,900 incremental closing and assignment delivery costs; numeric value: -32900.0; detail: Allocate $18,000 to incremental transaction counsel, $9,000 to licensed brokerage services where required, and $5,900 to escrow, recording, and buyer-package delivery. Exclude costs already charged to diligence.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $212,100 retained annual owner operating profit total; numeric value: 212100.0; detail: Final subtotal, not another upward movement. The canonical model does not separately specify owner salary or personal income taxes; do not describe this amount as after-tax take-home cash.

rect.title: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $505,000 annual earned fees and realized carry; numeric value: 505000.0; detail: Include only earned option assignments, per-MW origination milestones, and realized development carry. Where ASC 606 applies, assess principal versus agent presentation; exclude third-party pass-through billings when only the retained fee is operator revenue.

label: Recurring pod operating expense; value: −$132,000 annual recurring delivery and overhead costs; numeric value: -132000.0; detail: $11,000 monthly covers recurring contractor retainers, software, insurance, administration, and sourcing. This is the upper end of the canonical $1,800–$11,000 monthly operating range; exclude the separate project-specific charges below.

label: Direct site diligence expense; value: −$80,000 project-specific technical and land diligence; numeric value: -80000.0; detail: Allocate $36,000 to utility engineering and study support, $24,000 to environmental and survey work, and $20,000 to land-use and title investigation. These expenses exclude recurring pod retainers.

label: Expired option fee expense; value: −$48,000 recognized losses from unsuccessful site control; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Three failed positions at $16,000 each absorb nonrefundable option and extension fees after utility or zoning failure. Do not treat refundable deposits as losses or capitalize expired rights indefinitely.

label: Closed transaction expense; value: −$32,900 incremental closing and assignment delivery costs; numeric value: -32900.0; detail: Allocate $18,000 to incremental transaction counsel, $9,000 to licensed brokerage services where required, and $5,900 to escrow, recording, and buyer-package delivery. Exclude costs already charged to diligence.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $212,100 retained annual owner operating profit total; numeric value: 212100.0; detail: Final subtotal, not another upward movement. The canonical model does not separately specify owner salary or personal income taxes; do not describe this amount as after-tax take-home cash.

text.title: Assumptions: USD annually. First and final bars are totals; the four intermediate bars are signed expense movements. Base is $505,000 at 42.0%, producing $212,100 with the same pod. Scaled is $900,000 at 54%, producing $486,000 with 2 FT + 4 C.
